gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps its small counters unclogged and friendly. Shantell Sans sits above it as a wide-mouthed, hand-drawn display face, its horizontals as stout as its verticals while the body stays slim and light.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sarala: Marker-bright and a bit goofy up top. Sarala follows in a sans with distinct gaps in its letters and a glassy, neon-tube thickness, so paragraphs stay crisp and legible while Shantell Sans handles the personality.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text has open terminals that are simple to follow. Under Shantell Sans, whose rounds and stems all share one weight, it would carry a long passage in a plain sans manner, smooth and unfussy.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Loose, rope-like and playful. Shantell Sans keeps every stem and tail uniform, while ZCOOL XiaoWei tapers gently like a sharpened pencil line, so the two sit together as bold doodle and tidy sans.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-alpino: Alpino reads cozy and casual, its tall body making ascenders look short. Over a longer stretch its tight spacing and well-separated curve endings keep the text moving, a quiet foil to Sniglet's stubby, level headings.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text brings open terminals that are easy to follow. Sniglet's stroke never changes width and its terminals stop short of curling, so the heading and the sans body share a plain, level manner.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mukta-malar: Boisterous, stencil-cut and tall. Snowburst One's wide bridges and lofty lowercase clash productively with Mukta Malar, whose compressed ascenders make the sans-serif body feel quietly restrained.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-yantramanav: Stenciled, loud and tall-lowercased. Snowburst One brings the noise with wide bridges between its letters, while Yantramanav, a tidy sans with huddled letters and spacious terminal gaps, nearly matches its lowercase height.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-outfit: Cut-out stencil attitude, with tall lowercase and wide gaps. Outfit lets its curves finish well before they close, like bent cable in sans-serif form, so Snowburst One's rowdiness feels tamed beside it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-display: Glowing tube letters with a splayed c and a large x-height lead the way, their diagonals as thick as their horizontals. Noto Sans Display answers with a tall middle zone in every word.
